Interface GermanTaxMarketData

public interface GermanTaxMarketData
The market data the German tax calculation needs besides the transactions: closing exchange rates to euro, the prices and distributions of a fund for its advance lump sum, and the base interest rate of a year. Every method returns null for what is not known, so that the calculation can keep the gap visible instead of replacing it.

      The distributions of a fund unit in a calendar year.
